# SGLang /metrics exposition (--enable-metrics, served on :30000 — NOT vLLM's :8000).
# None of these names are recognized by the vLLM-oriented scraper (which reads vllm:*
# only), so Scrape must fail loud rather than emit fabricated zeros.
#
# Metric names, gauge types, and the priority="" total / priority="<int>" breakdown
# convention were verified against SGLang's SchedulerMetricsCollector at the image
# pinned in docs/reference-stack/VERSIONS.md; this file doubles as the reference name
# set for the per-engine extractor. Re-verify on a version bump — names have shifted
# across releases.
#
# What the scraper actually consumes (SGLang -> ReplicaStats):
#   sglang:num_running_reqs   (gauge)      -> pressure numerator (running)
#   sglang:num_queue_reqs     (gauge)      -> pressure numerator (waiting)
#   sglang:token_usage        (gauge 0-1)  -> cache_memory_bytes (usage x CacheSizeBytes)
#   sglang:cache_hit_rate     (gauge 0-1)  -> hit_rate, read DIRECTLY (NOT hits/queries delta)
# Present in a real exposition but NOT consumed today: sglang:gen_throughput,
# sglang:num_used_tokens (token_usage is used for the usage ratio instead).
# GAP: no core sglang:* external/T2-tier hit counters (vLLM has vllm:external_prefix_cache_*);
#      SGLang+LMCache T2 stats live in LMCache's own metrics — leave T2 unknown, do not fabricate.
# HELP sglang:num_running_reqs The number of running requests.
# TYPE sglang:num_running_reqs gauge
sglang:num_running_reqs{model_name="m"} 3
# HELP sglang:num_queue_reqs The number of requests in the waiting queue.
# TYPE sglang:num_queue_reqs gauge
sglang:num_queue_reqs{model_name="m"} 5
# HELP sglang:token_usage The token usage ratio (0-1).
# TYPE sglang:token_usage gauge
sglang:token_usage{model_name="m"} 0.63
# HELP sglang:num_used_tokens The number of used tokens.
# TYPE sglang:num_used_tokens gauge
sglang:num_used_tokens{model_name="m"} 1024
# HELP sglang:cache_hit_rate The prefix cache hit rate.
# TYPE sglang:cache_hit_rate gauge
sglang:cache_hit_rate{model_name="m"} 0.75
# HELP sglang:gen_throughput The generation throughput (token/s).
# TYPE sglang:gen_throughput gauge
sglang:gen_throughput{model_name="m"} 1500
# HELP sglang:prompt_tokens_total Number of prefill tokens processed.
# TYPE sglang:prompt_tokens_total counter
sglang:prompt_tokens_total{model_name="m"} 120000
# HELP sglang:generation_tokens_total Number of generation tokens processed.
# TYPE sglang:generation_tokens_total counter
sglang:generation_tokens_total{model_name="m"} 45000
